name: Sublimity AI Chatbot for Google Gemini
author: sublimitysoftwares

sections.description:
Sublimity AI Chatbot for Google Gemini is an intelligent AI-powered chatbot plugin for WordPress that leverages Google’s Gemini API to provide context-aware responses based on your website’s content. The chatbot can understand and respond to user queries by analyzing your site’s pages, posts, and other content.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Responses: Utilizes Google’s Gemini API for intelligent, context-aware conversations
  • Content Integration: Analyzes your website content to provide accurate, relevant responses
  • Customizable Design: Fully customizable chat interface to match your site’s branding
  • Multi-language Support: Supports multiple languages for global audiences
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track conversation metrics and user engagement
  • Easy Integration: Simple setup with minimal configuration required
  • Mobile Responsive: Optimized for all devices and screen sizes
  • Privacy Focused: Respects user privacy and GDPR compliance

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Valid Google Gemini API key
  • Backend API service (included)

Support

For support, please visit our website at https://sublimitysoft.com/wp-ai-chatbot or contact us at support@sublimitysoft.com.

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Please see our GitHub repository for contribution guidelines.

External Services

This plugin integrates with the following external services:

Google Gemini API

  • Service: Google Gemini API (Generative AI)
  • Purpose: Provides AI-powered conversational responses to user queries
  • Data Sent: User messages, conversation history, website content context
  • When Used: When users interact with the chatbot widget or shortcode
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • API Documentation: https://ai.google.dev/docs

The plugin sends user messages and relevant website content to Google Gemini API to generate contextual responses. No personal data is stored by Google unless explicitly configured in your Google Cloud project settings.

Backend API Service

  • Service: Backend API hosted at https://omnibot.sublimitysoft.in/api
  • Purpose: Provides additional processing and content indexing capabilities
  • Data Sent: Website content for indexing, user queries for enhanced context matching
  • When Used: During content indexing operations and when processing user queries that require enhanced context matching
  • Privacy Policy: https://sublimitysoft.com/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://sublimitysoft.com/terms-of-service

The backend service helps index your website content and provides enhanced context matching for better chatbot responses. Content is processed securely and in accordance with our privacy policy.

  • Various open-source libraries for enhanced functionality

sections.installation:
1. Upload the sublimity-ai-chatbot-gemini folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Sublimity AI Chatbot to configure the plugin
  4. Enter your Google Gemini API key
  5. Configure the chatbot appearance and behavior settings
  6. Add the chatbot widget to your site using the provided shortcode or widget
sections.faq:
How do I get a Google Gemini API key?

  1. Visit the Google AI Studio website
  2. Create a new project or select an existing one
  3. Enable the Gemini API for your project
  4. Generate an API key in the API credentials section
  5. Copy the API key and paste it in the plugin settings

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Yes! The plugin provides extensive customization options including:
– Chat widget colors and styling
– Chatbot avatar and branding
– Welcome messages and responses
– Chat window size and positioning

Does the plugin work with all WordPress themes?

The plugin is designed to be compatible with most modern WordPress themes. However, if you encounter any styling conflicts, you can use the built-in CSS overrides in the plugin settings.

Is the chatbot GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin includes GDPR compliance features:
– No personal data is stored without consent
– Users can opt-out of conversations
– Data retention policies can be configured
– Privacy notices are included in the chat interface

Can I integrate this with other AI services?

The plugin is specifically designed for Google Gemini API, but the architecture allows for future integration with other AI services through custom development.
